baseline_models.mechanism: The accusation and rebuttal oppose two models of textual making: speech that assigns false authorship and a humanly cut-and-joined artifact versus discourse whose weave holds because it matches reality.

activation_trace.role: Literal attribution of what was not said makes the accusation itself an act of assigning false authorship.
Literal cutting for repair and stitching supplies the accusers' model of a text assembled by hand.
Literal invention of a lie keeps the ordinary charge present beneath the material assembly image.
Literal tight weaving in cloth or speech gives the rebuttal an image of internally integral composition.
Literal stability matching reality makes that compositional integrity answerable to truth, not elegance alone.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply denies that Muhammad invented the message.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages rival accounts of the text's production: a falsely attributed patchwork is opposed by a tightly integrated discourse whose source and fit to reality belong together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ما أتاهم من نذير من قبلك لعلهم يهتدون
baseline_models.mechanism: A temporal absence is repaired by an arrival that awakens caution and opens orientation: first contact, not threat by itself, is the enabling event for pathfinding.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and arrival marks the missing event that the present warning now supplies.
Literal temporal precedence turns the community's condition into a before-and-now sequence.
Literal fear-producing warning functions as an awakening of caution rather than the destination.
Literal gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies the process that warning is meant to enable.

changed_reading.before: An uninformed people are warned so that they might accept correct doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The first arrival interrupts inherited non-orientation: alarm wakes attention, but guidance remains the people's subsequent movement along a newly indicated way.

baseline_models.mechanism: The Lordly source makes warning part of gradual cultivation; the addressed people are not a fixed mass but a body capable of rising into deliberate direction.

activation_trace.role: Literal repair, nurture, and completion recasts the source relation as developmental care.
Literal resolve and rising toward an affair makes the people a potential responding body, not just an ethnic label.
Literal awakening through fear provides the disruptive phase within the nurturing process.
Literal direction, manner, and intended course supplies the positive shape into which the people may rise.

changed_reading.before: Lordship authorizes a warning delivered to a people.
changed_reading.after: Lordship names a developmental intervention in which warning jars a community awake so it can rise into a sustained course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding descent of a composed Book with no oscillating doubt gives the focus rebuttal a provenance mechanism: what looks horizontally assembled is presented as delivered into place from the same Lordly source.

activation_trace.role: Literal cutting and stitching remains the human assembly model being challenged.
Literal tightly woven speech supplies the focus text's counter-image of compositional integrity.
Literal causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies vertical delivery as the alternative production path.
Literal joining of one thing to another makes the Book composed without conceding fabricated authorship.
Literal oscillation of doubt contrasts with the fixed fit carried by الحق.

structural_cues: 32:2 places تنزيل الكتاب and من رب العالمين immediately before the accusation, while 32:3 repeats the source construction من ربك.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, composition, denied doubt, and repeated Lordly provenance; I infer that these answer the mechanics of the fabrication charge, while the live alternative is a simpler assertion of origin without a compositional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The rebuttal replaces a false authorship claim with a bare divine-source claim.
changed_reading.after: The rebuttal opposes horizontal human patching with delivered composition: joined discourse can be genuinely composed while its descent, placement, and reality-fit deny invented authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between giving every soul its guidance and the binding word prevents the focus purpose clause from becoming a prediction of universal uptake: warning creates a real route without compelling traversal.

activation_trace.role: Literal gentle indication to a path keeps focus guidance an offered process.
The same literal path-indication is explicitly imagined as something that could have been given to every soul.
Literal giving distinguishes universally bestowed guidance from the focus verse's warning-enabled possibility.
Literal binding obligation and fixed entitlement makes the countervailing word consequential rather than hypothetical.
Literal articulated speech gives that binding outcome the form of a declared word.

structural_cues: The conditional ولو شئنا ... ولكن in 32:13 directly qualifies the open-ended لعلهم of 32:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unrealized universal gift of guidance and a contrasting fulfilled word; I infer a difference between enabling guidance and coercing it, while the live alternative treats 32:13 only as a separate decree scene.

changed_reading.before: The purpose of warning implies that the addressed people will be guided.
changed_reading.after: Warning establishes a genuine possibility of guided movement, but لعلهم preserves noncoercive contingency rather than promising the response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lesser-before-greater sequence makes warning a staged intervention: an early painful check remains reversible and is ordered toward return before terminal consequence.

activation_trace.role: Literal fear that awakens caution supplies the early interruptive function of warning.
Literal path-indication names the recoverable movement that the interruption seeks.
Literal painful punishment supplies graded consequence on both the lesser and greater sides of the interval.
Literal turning back from a wrong supplies the intended reversible outcome of the lesser check.

structural_cues: 32:21 orders العذاب الأدنى before العذاب الأكبر and repeats the focus cadence لعلهم, now with يرجعون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graded consequence, temporal precedence, and hoped-for return; I infer that the focus warning belongs to this corrective interval, while it can alternatively remain only verbal notice of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The warner announces danger so the people may choose the right belief.
changed_reading.after: The warner opens a recoverable interval: caution and lesser checks are meaningful because return is still possible before the greater closure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses' Book becoming guidance and patient, certain leaders guiding by command place the present warner inside a transmissible architecture; the focus absence is local to this people, not an absolute absence of prior guidance.

activation_trace.role: Literal temporal precedence marks the claimed gap before the present addressee.
Literal indication toward path and truth shows a prior Book functioning as guidance for another addressed community.
Literal advance of a guide turns guidance from a static possession into mediated leading.
Literal exemplar who is followed supplies the human relay in the guidance chain.
Literal restraint of the self from panic supplies the endurance condition for sustained mediation.
Literal settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic condition for reliable leading.

structural_cues: The relational phrase من قبلك limits the focus absence to what reached this قوم before this messenger; 32:23-24 then names an earlier Book, community, and leaders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a local recipient phrase and a later Book-to-leaders sequence; I infer parallel transmission rather than direct institutional continuity, while the live alternative keeps the two communities wholly separate.

changed_reading.before: No warning existed before the present message.
changed_reading.after: Earlier guidance existed elsewhere and could become a durable leadership chain; the novelty is this warning's arrival to this people and the possibility of beginning such mediation among them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Walking through the dwellings of destroyed generations creates a pre-verbal guidance field, yet the closing demand to hear shows that traces do not interpret themselves; the present spoken warning makes inhabited ruins audible.

activation_trace.role: Literal arrival preserves the distinction between ambient traces and a warner who personally reaches the people.
Literal path-indication lets destroyed settlements themselves pose a guidance question.
Literal fall into extinction supplies the absent lives whose remains bear warning.
Literal walking makes the addressees bodily traverse the evidence rather than receive it abstractly.
Literal settled habitation turns the former homes into durable social traces.
Literal understanding and compliance makes hearing the conversion of mute evidence into actionable warning.

structural_cues: 32:26 runs from guidance, through destroyed predecessors and walked dwellings, to signs and the question أفلا يسمعون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ruins, embodied traversal, signs, and hearing; I infer that speech interprets an already visible warning field, while the live alternative treats the ruins only as later corroboration unrelated to the focus absence.

changed_reading.before: Because no warner came, the people had no warning material at all.
changed_reading.after: They may inhabit a landscape of consequences without having received an explicit warner; the present message converts those mute traces into heard, actionable guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus arrival branch of a flood reaching land that received no rain locks onto the later driven-water sequence: a first warner can be read as externally conducted life-bearing input to socially barren ground, with guidance as the resulting growth and sight.

activation_trace.role: Literal floodwater arriving from a rained land into one without rain supplies the precise analogical hinge for a warner reaching an unvisited people.
Literal warning that awakens caution functions as the life-bearing input rather than as devastation.
Literal gentle path-indication supplies the human orientation that corresponds to revived growth.
Literal driving and conducting supplies agency that carries the needed input toward its recipient.
Literal land stripped of vegetation supplies the recipient state before arrival.
Literal germination and cultivation supplies the latent response released after contact.
Literal seeing makes awakened perception the endpoint of the water-and-growth demonstration.

structural_cues: 32:27 orders conducted water, barren land, emergent crop, nourishment, and the appeal أفلا يبصرون; this mirrors focus arrival, warning, and hoped-for guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the unusually specific incoming-flood branch at focus and a later full irrigation mechanism; I map water to warning and growth to guidance, while the live alternative confines 32:27 to providence or resurrection evidence.

changed_reading.before: The first warner delivers information to a community that previously lacked it.
changed_reading.after: The first warning is an irrigation event: provision is conducted from beyond a barren reception history, awakening growth, nourishment, perception, and possible self-orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenged opening becomes a terminal threshold at which late belief no longer benefits and no delay remains; warning therefore belongs to the still-open interval before verification becomes coercive and useless.

activation_trace.role: Literal temporal precedence extends from prior absence to the urgent interval before closure.
Literal caution-awakening warning has value while response can still precede decisive disclosure.
Literal opening of what was closed supplies the challengers' demanded moment of disclosure.
Literal truthfulness of speech makes the demand for opening a test of the focus truth claim.
Literal judgment that breaks closure turns the requested opening into decisive adjudication.
Literal benefit opposed to harm marks late belief as no longer capable of changing the outcome.
Literal waiting and granting delay supplies the reprieve explicitly absent after the opening.

structural_cues: The question متى هذا الفتح in 32:28 is answered by the paired negations لا ينفع and لا هم ينظرون in 32:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demanded disclosure followed by useless late faith and no reprieve; I infer that focus warning occupies the prior response window, while the live alternative reads الفتح as a separate victory scene.

changed_reading.before: Warning supplies evidence that can be accepted whenever verification arrives.
changed_reading.after: Warning is valuable precisely before compelled verification: once the closed matter opens into judgment, assent can no longer become beneficial guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping, not the ordinary lexeme; it remains anchored at يقولون and sharpened by the explicit الحق contrast, but downstream prose should label it a split-root acoustic-material activation rather than a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Literal oscillation, movement, and lack of settled place makes the accusation vibrate as unstable talk.
Literal fixed correspondence with reality supplies the still point against which that verbal oscillation is felt.

changed_reading.before: Their accusation and the rebuttal are two propositions of the same kind.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory sound-material level, the accusation is unsettled verbal motion, while الحق answers as fixed reality rather than merely a louder counterclaim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's ه د ي to ه د د split and lets destruction shadow guidance; it remains anchored in يهتدون and gains local support when 32:26 places guidance beside annihilated generations, but prose should present it only as an averted-outcome resonance, never as the lexical meaning of يهتدون.

activation_trace.role: Literal threat that awakens caution provides the preventive force before damage.
Literal severe breaking and demolition supplies the split-root outcome that guided movement may avert.
Literal threat and intimidation makes the later guidance question carry a warning-shadow without replacing its path sense.
Literal fall into annihilation supplies the visible historical endpoint that makes the averted breaking concrete.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only positive indication toward a road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guided movement is also the path taken before warning hardens into historical breaking; the hoped-for orientation is defined partly by the ruin it averts.

strongest_changes: 32:13 revises لعلهم يهتدون from expected conversion to a real but noncoercive possibility.
32:21 and 32:28-29 make warning a recoverable yet time-bounded interval before consequence closes response.
32:27 activates the exact incoming-flood branch of ء ت ي, recasting a first warner's arrival as irrigation of previously unwatered social ground.
32:23-26 distinguish absence of a prior personal warner from both earlier guidance elsewhere and material traces already traversed.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is organized by rival mechanisms, not a single gloss: patched fabrication versus integral truth, first arrival versus prior absence, warning versus freely taken orientation, and an unusually precise water-arrival analogy. Non-dominant ق ل ل and ه د د mappings preserve two contained acoustic-material shadows without displacing the dominant roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The irrigation mapping is unusually exact but remains a reader-supplied analogy; 32:27 can independently serve providence or resurrection argument.
The Book-and-leaders sequence supports a parallel guidance architecture, but it does not itself establish direct continuity with the focus community.
The ق ل ل and ه د د activations are packet-licensed split-root resonances, not lexical readings, and should remain explicitly exploratory.
